name: wallet-requests
description: Valid and malformed wallet requests on two wallet nodes (X on this role's jar, Y on the other's), each holding one token it issued: payments, issuance and burns through /wallet/transaction/generate, box collection through /wallet/boxes/collect, payments through /wallet/payment/send. Per node, every valid request builds the expected outputs and every malformed one (1-, 31-, 33-byte or non-hex token ids, a corrupted address, a missing value, an empty object) is refused; across the jars, the valid requests give the same request-derived outputs. Written for ergoplatform/ergo#2390 (wallet request token ids decoded only at 32 bytes; the transaction request subtype chosen by its fields, with no fallback after a decoding error).
